meta.title: Workshop Operator Reference
meta.subtitle: ALMONA Fabricator Pro — manufacturing gates, revision identity, and floor procedures
meta.standards: Industrial computing · deterministic constraints · human validation required

principles.heading: Five floor principles
principles.intro: Every operator must apply these rules on every pose. They are manufacturing constraints, not preferences.

items.title: Human validation
items.body: Software proposes cuts and checks stock. A person qualifies the BOM, acknowledges stock, freezes release, and signs QC.
items.result: Result: fewer wrong cut lists; clear responsibility at each gate.

items.title: No self-approved manufacturing authority
items.body: You may request catalogue and cutting-rule review. Approval is performed by a trusted backend review process. The browser cannot approve itself.
items.result: Result: manufacturing authority stays auditable; no operator self-certification loophole.

items.title: Soft stock acknowledgement
items.body: Acknowledgement checks coverage for the active revision. It does not remove metres from the ledger.
items.result: Result: inventory remains accurate; availability and consumption stay separate.

items.title: Revision discipline (R#)
items.body: Every saved change to a position bumps R#. Stock acknowledgement, BOM, optimization, release, and QC must match the same R#.
items.result: Result: cuts and QC always refer to one manufacturing identity.

items.title: Owner scope
items.body: Packs and stock belong to the signed-in account (owner_user_id). They are not company-wide unless you share that owner account under workshop policy.
items.result: Result: no accidental cross-workshop stock or pack leakage.

pipeline.heading: Gated manufacturing pipeline
pipeline.intro: Complete each step honestly. Blocked means a prerequisite is missing — resolve it before continuing.

steps.label: Design
steps.gate: Resolve the system pack (frame + sash profiles).

steps.label: BOM
steps.gate: Request catalogue / cutting-rule review; regenerate when qualified.

steps.label: Stock acknowledgement
steps.gate: Soft acknowledgement for the active R#.

steps.label: Production → QC → Delivery
steps.gate: Same R# freeze and inspection evidence.

revision.heading: Revision discipline (R#)
revision.identity: Workflow identity: owner + project + position + source + revision
revision.what: R# is the manufacturing revision counter for a pose (R1, R2, R3…). It is part of the saved workflow identity.
revision.when: R# increases when you save measurement, design, or other position writes.
revision.rule_body: When R# increments: previous soft stock acknowledgements are stale; regenerate and re-qualify the BOM; re-acknowledge stock before optimization. Never optimize or release against a mismatched revision.
revision.evidence: Assessment evidence: screenshot of the active R# in the studio chrome (status bar).

roles.heading: Roles and workshop scope
roles.register: Self-service registration at /register creates the customer role only. Technician and admin cannot be selected in the browser.
roles.privileged: Technician and admin roles require privileged server-side provisioning (service-role / ALMONA operations).
roles.shared_body: Create one owner account for packs, stock, and live jobs. Grant technician or admin roles only through the admin panel / service role — not by inventing shared company-wide inventory from the registration form.

packs.heading: System packs, profiles, and tuning
packs.examples: Catalogue examples in this product: ROCK 60, JUMBO 100, KALE 70, ASAS — plus owner-scoped custom packs.
packs.roles: Assign correct profile roles (frame, sash, and others as required). Wrong roles break BOM cuts and stock demand matching.
packs.tuning: Tuning paths: No-DXF /fabricator/studio/data/tuning-no-dxf · DXF /fabricator/studio/data/tuning. Save until the pack shows Tuned.
packs.note: Tuned means pack geometry / cutting readiness. It does not grant manufacturing authority for a specific pose. Pose BOM still needs approved catalogue and cutting-rule evidence for that revision.

stock.heading: Stock intake and soft acknowledgement
stock.wizard: Purchase Wizard: select pack profiles by role, quantities, and bar lengths to materialize owned inventory.
stock.invoice: Invoice intake: record quantity, bar length, invoice number, and supplier against owned profiles.
stock.soft: Acknowledge stock: soft availability check for the active revision — does not deduct the ledger.
stock.add: Purchase / invoice: adds metres (or equivalent) to owned inventory.
stock.test: Lots marked for testing are inspection inventory. Keep them out of operational readiness calculations.

rows.cause: Custom pack not resolved for this account
rows.action: Confirm the pack is saved for this owner; reload gallery; complete No-DXF save if needed.

rows.cause: Pack not resolved for BOM review
rows.action: Ensure the pack is owned and available; regenerate from Design → Review BOM.

rows.cause: Missing soft acknowledgement or mismatched R#
rows.action: Open Stock → Acknowledge for the current R#.
Request / check manufacturing approval; regenerate BOM.
Obtain workshop-approved tolerance evidence. Do not invent values.

assessment.heading: Operator assessment checklist
assessment.intro: Mark Pass only with live evidence. Memory is not evidence.
assessment.mandatory_chrome: Mandatory: screenshot of the active R# in the studio chrome.
items: Explained active revision R# and when it bumps
Stated that registration creates customer only; technician/admin need privileged setup
Verified pack with frame + sash roles (catalogue example or owned custom pack)
Confirmed pack shows Tuned (or documented why not)
Requested catalogue + cutting-rule review (or documented pending reviewer)
Completed project → measure → design → BOM under a saved R#
Soft-acknowledged stock for that exact R#
Completed optimization with placed cuts for that R#
Attached screenshot of active R# chrome as assessment evidence
